Support the Sabha
Mission

Our Mission

We cultivate a welcoming sabha where knowledge flows between gurus, students, and rasikas, safeguarding classical traditions while encouraging new expressions.

Guiding Principles

  • Access: Monthly gatherings are free or donation-based so every family can participate.
  • Mentorship: Pairing young musicians with gurus and senior performers for sustained guidance.
  • Diversity: Showcasing Hindustani and Carnatic styles, vocal and instrumental, traditional and contemporary.
  • Community: Encouraging families to volunteer, host artists, and share hospitality.

How we deliver impact

Donations and volunteer time directly support scholarships, artist honorariums, travel stipends, venue rentals, and archival work that preserves each performance.

We partner with gurus, music schools, and cultural organizations to create immersive learning experiences—from tanpura meditation circles to advanced tala workshops.
